title: 3'-hydroxypuerarin mitigates LPS-induced acute lung injury by inhibiting TLR4 activation-mediated NF-kappaB p65/NLRP3/GSDMD signaling.
authors: Hu, Huiyu; Wang, Kongyan; Qiu, Yi; Xu, Zaibin; Chen, Yan; Hu, Yingjie; Huang, Jiawen; Luo, Zhuohui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究3'-羟基葛根素通过抑制TLR4/NF-κB/NLRP3/GSDMD信号通路缓解LPS诱导的急性肺损伤，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白（TLR4）互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Acute lung injury (ALI) is a common critical respiratory illness. 3'-Hydroxypuerarin (3HP), a beneficial isoflavone from Pueraria lobata (Willd.) Ohwi, possesses significant pharmacological activities, but its effects on ALI remain limited. METHODS: To investigate the role of 3HP in mitigating ALI, in vivo lipopolysaccharide (LPS)- induced ALI in mice and in vitro LPS-induced RAW264.7 macrophage inflammatory injury were carried out using ELISA kits, RT-qPCR, immunofluorescence, Western blotting, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation analyses. RESULTS: 3HP significantly reduced IL6 and TNF-alpha levels in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) and serum, attenuated pulmonary edema, inhibited the mRNA levels of chemokines and inflammatory factors in lung tissues, and suppressed the expression of IL1beta, IL6, TNF-alpha, HMGB1, TLR4, MyD88, p-IkappaBalpha (S32/S36), p-NF-kappaB p65 (S536), COX2, iNOS, ICAM1, VCAM1, NLRP3, ASC, Caspase-1, Cleaved Caspase-1 (Ala317) p10, NEK7, Caspase-8, IL18, GSDMD, and GSDMD N-terminal both in lung tissues and in RAW264.7 cells, indicating that 3HP inhibited LPS-stimulated TLR4 activation, thereby reducing IkappaBalpha phosphorylation and degradation, and preventing NF-kappaB p65 nuclear translocation to mediate the transcription and expression of inflammatory mediators. It also inhibited NLRP3 inflammasome activation, decreased Caspase-1 cleavage of GSDMD, and lowered the release of the pore-forming GSDMD N-terminal structural domain, blocking the immune response to pyroptosis. Moreover, the NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950 enhanced the effect of 3HP on acute cellular inflammatory injury. Notably, molecular docking and dynamics simulation revealed that 3HP stably bound to TLR4. Resatorvid (TAK-242), a selective TLR4 signaling inhibitor, significantly enhanced 3HP's inhibitory effect on TLR4, further indicating that 3HP may block the NF-kappaB p65/NLRP3/GSDMD signaling pathway by inhibiting TLR4 activation in response to LPS stimulation. CONCLUSIONS: Our results demonstrated that 3HP mitigates LPS-induced ALI by inhibiting TLR4 activation-mediated NF-kappaB p65/NLRP3/GSDMD signaling. These findings provide scientific evidence for the clinical treatment of ALI and present new insights into the pharmacological role of 3HP in mitigating acute lung inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 引言：急性肺损伤（ALI）是一种常见的危重呼吸系统疾病。3'-羟基葛根素（3HP）是从葛根（Pueraria lobata (Willd.) Ohwi）中提取的一种有益异黄酮，具有显著的药理活性，但其对ALI的作用仍有限。方法：为研究3HP在缓解ALI中的作用，采用ELISA试剂盒、RT-qPCR、免疫荧光、Western blotting、分子对接和分子动力学模拟分析，进行了体内脂多糖（LPS）诱导的小鼠ALI和体外LPS诱导的RAW264.7巨噬细胞炎症损伤实验。结果：3HP显著降低了支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）和血清中IL6和TNF-alpha的水平，减轻了肺水肿，抑制了肺组织中趋化因子和炎症因子的mRNA水平，并在肺组织和RAW264.7细胞中抑制了IL1beta、IL6、TNF-alpha、HMGB1、TLR4、MyD88、p-IkappaBalpha（S32/S36）、p-NF-kappaB p65（S536）、COX2、iNOS、ICAM1、VCAM1、NLRP3、ASC、Caspase-1、Cleaved Caspase-1（Ala317）p10、NEK7、Caspase-8、IL18、GSDMD和GSDMD N端片段的表达，表明3HP抑制了LPS刺激的TLR4激活，从而减少IkappaBalpha磷酸化和降解，并阻止NF-kappaB p65核转位以介导炎症介质的转录和表达。它还抑制了NLRP3炎症小体激活，减少了Caspase-1对GSDMD的切割，并降低了成孔GSDMD N端结构域的释放，阻断了细胞焦亡的免疫反应。此外，NLRP3抑制剂MCC950增强了3HP对急性细胞炎症损伤的作用。值得注意的是，分子对接和动力学模拟显示，3HP与TLR4稳定结合。选择性TLR4信号抑制剂Resatorvid（TAK-242）显著增强了3HP对TLR4的抑制作用，进一步表明3HP可能通过抑制TLR4激活来阻断LPS刺激下的NF-kappaB p65/NLRP3/GSDMD信号通路。结论：我们的结果表明，3HP通过抑制TLR4激活介导的NF-kappaB p65/NLRP3/GSDMD信号通路来缓解LPS诱导的ALI。这些发现为ALI的临床治疗提供了科学依据，并为3HP在缓解急性肺部炎症性疾病中的药理作用提供了新见解。
